statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (xs xs_1 : Option α) (e_xs : xs = xs_1) (P : α → Prop) (H : ∀ (x : α), xs = some x → P x), xs.attachWith P H = xs_1.attachWith P ⋯

name: core_Option_attachWith_guard
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {q : α → Bool} {x : α} {P : α → Prop} {h : ∀ (a : α), Option.guard q x = some a → P a}, (Option.guard q x).attachWith P h = if h' : q x = true then some ⟨x, ⋯⟩ else none

name: core_Option_attach_guard
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {x : α}, (Option.guard p x).attach = if h : p x = true then some ⟨x, ⋯⟩ else none

name: core_Option_attach_pfilter
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o : Option α} {p : (a : α) → o = some a → Bool}, (o.pfilter p).attach = o.attach.pbind fun x h => if h' : p x.val ⋯ = true then some ⟨x.val, ⋯⟩ else none

name: core_Option_filter_pmap
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {o : Option α} {p : α → Prop} {f : (a : α) → p a → β} {h : ∀ (a : α), o = some a → p a} {q : β → Bool}, Option.filter q (Option.pmap f o h) = Option.pmap f (o.pfilter fun a h' => q (f a ⋯)) ⋯

name: core_Option_forIn'_toArray
statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] (o : Option α) (b : β) (f : (a : α) → a ∈ o.toArray → β → m (ForInStep β)), forIn' o.toArray b f = forIn' o b fun a m b => f a ⋯ b

name: core_Option_get!_inj
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Inhabited α] {o₁ o₂ : Option α}, o₁.isSome = true → o₂.isSome = true → (o₁.get! = o₂.get! ↔ o₁ = o₂)

name: core_Option_getD_inj
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o₁ o₂ : Option α}, o₁.isSome = true → o₂.isSome = true → ∀ {fallback : α}, o₁.getD fallback = o₂.getD fallback ↔ o₁ = o₂

name: core_Option_get_pbind
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {o : Option α} {f : (a : α) → o = some a → Option β} {h : (o.pbind f).isSome = true}, (o.pbind f).get h = (f (o.get ⋯) ⋯).get ⋯

name: core_Option_get_pmap
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Bool} {f : (x : α) → p x = true → β} {o : Option α} {h : ∀ (a : α), o = some a → p a = true} {h' : (Option.pmap f o h).isSome = true}, (Option.pmap f o h).get h' = f (o.get ⋯) ⋯

name: core_Option_guard_or_guard
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {a : α} {q : α → Bool}, (Option.guard p a).or (Option.guard q a) = Option.guard (fun x => p x || q x) a

name: core_Option_instIdempotentOpOr
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, Std.IdempotentOp Option.or

name: core_Option_instReflOrd
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Ord α] [Std.ReflOrd α], Std.ReflOrd (Option α)

name: core_Option_instTransOrd
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Ord α] [Std.TransOrd α], Std.TransOrd (Option α)

name: core_Option_isSome_choice_iff_nonempty
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, (Option.choice α).isSome = true ↔ Nonempty α

name: core_Option_isSome_none
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, none.isSome = false

name: core_Option_join_ne_none'
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : Option (Option α)}, ¬x.join = none ↔ ∃ z, x = some (some z)

name: core_Option_mapM_join
statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Applicative m] [LawfulApplicative m] {f : α → m β} {o : Option (Option α)}, Option.mapM f o.join = Option.join <$> Option.mapM (Option.mapM f) o

name: core_Option_map_comp_map
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ), Option.map g ∘ Option.map f = Option.map (g ∘ f)

name: core_Option_map_inj_right
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} {o o' : Option α}, (∀ (x y : α), f x = f y → x = y) → (Option.map f o = Option.map f o' ↔ o = o')

name: core_Option_max_le
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : Max α], (∀ (x y z : α), max x y ≤ z ↔ x ≤ z ∧ y ≤ z) → ∀ {a b c : Option α}, max a b ≤ c ↔ a ≤ c ∧ b ≤ c

name: core_Option_merge_le
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LE α] {f : α → α → α} {o₁ o₂ o₃ : Option α}, (∀ (a b c : α), a ≤ c → b ≤ c → f a b ≤ c) → o₁ ≤ o₃ → o₂ ≤ o₃ → Option.merge f o₁ o₂ ≤ o₃

name: core_Option_merge_lt
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LT α] {f : α → α → α} {o₁ o₂ o₃ : Option α}, (∀ (a b c : α), a < c → b < c → f a b < c) → o₁ < o₃ → o₂ < o₃ → Option.merge f o₁ o₂ < o₃

name: core_Option_min_join_right
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Min α] {o : Option α} {o' : Option (Option α)}, min o o'.join = (min (some o) o').join

name: core_Option_not_comp_isNone
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, (fun x => !x) ∘ Option.isNone = Option.isSome

name: core_Option_pbind_some
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {α_1 : Type u_2} {f : (a_1 : α) → some a = some a_1 → Option α_1}, (some a).pbind f = f a ⋯

name: core_Option_pelim_guard
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {β : Sort u_2} {b : β} {a : α} {f : (a' : α) → Option.guard p a = some a' → β}, (Option.guard p a).pelim b f = if h : p a = true then f a ⋯ else b

name: core_Option_pfilter_congr
statement: ∀ {α : Type u} {o o' : Option α} (ho : o = o') {f : (a : α) → o = some a → Bool} {g : (a : α) → o' = some a → Bool}, (∀ (a : α) (ha : o' = some a), f a ⋯ = g a ha) → o.pfilter f = o'.pfilter g

name: core_Option_pfilter_join
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o : Option (Option α)} {p : (a : α) → o.join = some a → Bool}, o.join.pfilter p = (o.pfilter fun o' h => o'.pelim false fun a ha => p a ⋯).join

name: core_Option_pmap_map
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} (o : Option α) (f : α → β) {p : β → Prop} (g : (b : β) → p b → γ) (H : ∀ (a : β), Option.map f o = some a → p a), Option.pmap g (Option.map f o) H = Option.pmap (fun a h => g (f a) h) o ⋯

name: core_Option_right_le_max
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : Max α], (∀ (x : α), x ≤ x) → (∀ (x y : α), y ≤ max x y) → ∀ {a b : Option α}, b ≤ max a b

name: core_Option_unattach_filter
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {o : Option { x // p x }} {f : { x // p x } → Bool} {g : α → Bool}, (∀ (x : α) (h : p x), f ⟨x, h⟩ = g x) → (Option.filter f o).unattach = Option.filter g o.unattach
